title: Threads.
logline: The quokka ties its island together, one link at a time.

story.setup: Notes sit like huts along the tide line, unconnected.
story.turn: It strings [[links]] between them; a rope to a hut that doesn't exist yet hangs slack (a link to nothing looks inert). ⌘K finds any note, file, chat or action.
story.payoff: Views arrange the same huts two ways without moving a single one; panes put two side by side.

features.claim: Wikilinks connect notes. A link to nothing looks inert, never live.
⌘K finds every note, file, chat, and action. ⌘T starts a note and ⌘N chooses what a new tab becomes.
Panes and tabs split with ⌘D and ⌘⇧D; every hotkey can be rebound.
Main and named views arrange the same files without copying them.
